status_note: Day complete. Double espresso at 12:15, a big lunch at 13:35 (baked potatoes, 270 g denis fish, baked cherry tomatoes and red onion, 0.75 of a large caesar-mozzarella salad with homemade vinaigrette), 2nd double espresso + omega-3 mid-afternoon, honeydew melon snack, multivitamin at 17:48, a dairy/egg-forward dinner at 18:45 (2 protein spelt pitas, yellow cheese, labaneh, 2 fried eggs, 20 cherry tomatoes), a Legs workout at 21:00 (3 PRs), then a protein yogurt and 5g creatine to close the day. Total ~2,131 kcal, ~178 g protein, ~162 g carb, ~97 g fat, ~41 g fiber, 4 caffeine shots — a strong all-round day: protein well past target, fiber more than doubled target, calories landed just over target. Weigh-in shows continued slow progress: 80.95 kg (down from 81.4 kg baseline), body fat 27.0% (down from 27.3%). Sleep tracking now added — 11.25h logged last night (catch-up sleep post-travel). Also fixed a real bug in the workout dashboard's time-of-day stat (was mislabeling afternoon sessions as 'evening', and half the underlying timestamps turned out to be placeholders).
